name: Lumatrix

abilityDetails.Fractured Power Bar: Şampiyon, elindeki güç barına göre farklı özel saldırı türlerini belirli olasılıklarla kullanır.
abilityDetails.Endurance: Aktifken, etkilenen şampiyon üzerindeki yeni hasarsız debuff'ların süresini azaltır.
abilityDetails.Guaranteed Crits: Tüm vuruşlar garanti kritik vuruş olur.
abilityDetails.Evade: Rakip saldırılarından otomatik olarak kaçmayı sağlar.
abilityDetails.Fury: Saldırı gücünü geçici olarak büyük ölçüde artırır.

howToPlay: Bu şampiyona karşı (savunmada): Ağır saldırı yüklerken 2sn'lik kaçış yükü kazanır; kaçarsa görünmez olur ve pasif sersemletir — kaçış-karşıtı şampiyon şart. Güç barları kırık olduğu için 2 bar dolu olsa bile E1 kullanabilir (öngörülemez). E1 kullanırsa pasif görünmezlik kazanır.
bestUse: Bu şampiyon genel maceralarda ve Skill sınıfı avantajı olan yollarda en iyi performansı gösterir.
signatureAbility:
The Shining Assassin
When a non-Damaging Debuff on Lumatrix expires naturally, Passively reduce incoming damage by [30 - 60]%.
The Opponent's Instant Damaging effects have their Ability Accuracy reduced by [20 - 45]%, doubled when fighting Science Champions.

abilitySections.title: Always Active - Skilled Eidol Physiology
content: Lumatrix is a Skill Eidol and thus has a Fractured Power Bar and is Immune to Bleed and Rupture effects.
Personal effects other than Fury are paused during the Opponent's Special Attacks.
Start each fight with an indefinite 25% Endurance Passive. When the Opponent Misses while Lumatrix is Blocking, also gain a 25% Endurance Passive for 20 seconds. Max stacks: 3.
Lumatrix can charge their Heavy Attack for 4 seconds, and their Heavy Attack hits grant the Opponent 20% less Power. While Invisible, this reduction is extended to all hits.

abilitySections.title: Cunning - Max: 8
content: Lumatrix's 40% Cunning Passives last 12 seconds, and 1 Cunning is gained when Lumatrix has 1 or more full Bars of Power remaining after activating a Special Attack.
Gaining Lumatrix's Cunning refreshes all personal Cunning. While Lumatrix's Cunning is at max, all hits are Guaranteed Critical Hits.

abilitySections.title: Misdirection - Evade
content: When Lumatrix starts charging their Heavy Attack, they gain an Evade Charge for 2 seconds. This starts indefinitely paused, and will not activate while Invisible or while Lumatrix's Invisibility is on cooldown.
When Lumatrix stops charging their Heavy Attack, this Evade Charge is removed. As a Defender, this is unpaused instead.
Against non-Mutant Opponents, gaining this Evade Charge also inflicts the Opponent with a Tracking Passive for 5 seconds.
While this Evade Charge is active, Lumatrix gains a 100% chance to Evade Basic Attacks.
The Opponent becomes more aggressive while this Evade Charge is active, or while Invisible.
Performing any Evade consumes the Evade Charge and grants 1 Cunning. Performing a personal Evade also inflicts a Stun Passive for 1 second.

abilitySections.title: Deception - Invisibility
content: After performing an Evade, Lumatrix gains an Invisibility Passive for 3 seconds, paused during Lumatrix's attacks. As an Attacker, activating a Special Attack while the Evade Charge is active also grants this Invisibility.
While Invisible or while Lumatrix is performing their Special Attack 1, gain Stun Immunity, increase personal Cunning potency by 100%, and pause all personal effects other than Invisibility and Stun.
When the Opponent is knocked down by a Heavy Attack or when the Opponent activates a Special Attack, this Invisibility is removed.
If this Invisibility ends without Lumatrix knocking the Opponent down with a Heavy Attack, it goes on cooldown for 20 seconds.
This cooldown is removed by punishing a Special Attack, activating a Special Attack, or by knocking the Opponent down with a Heavy Attack.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 1
content: On activation, gain 1 Cunning.
Just before the final hit, activate Invisibility. If already Invisible, also gain an Unblockable Passive for 2 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 2
content: On activation, gain 3 Cunning. As a Defender, also gain Lumatrix's Evade Charge, and pause it until the end of this Special Attack.
On the first landed hit, gain a +[7,113] Fury Passive for 20 seconds. If Unblockable, gain 1 additional Fury Passive. Max stacks: 2.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 3
content: On activation, gain 7 Cunning, activate Invisibility, and pause it for 10 seconds.
While this pause is active, Lumatrix's Invisibility will not be removed when the Opponent is knocked down by a Heavy Attack or when the Opponent activates a Special Attack.

abilitySections.title: Signature Ability - The Shining Assassin
content: When a non-Damaging Debuff on Lumatrix expires naturally, Passively reduce incoming damage by [30 - 60]%.
The Opponent's Instant Damaging effects have their Ability Accuracy reduced by [20 - 45]%, doubled when fighting Science Champions.
